dataset: NuFIT 6.1 (2025), IC24 with Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data
fit_note: Gaussian approximation for Numerical.OscillationFit. NuFIT reports asymmetric one-sigma intervals; each one_sigma_errors entry here is the arithmetic mean of the quoted +1sigma and -1sigma errors. Correlations are not included. This is not a reproduction of the official NuFIT Delta-chi2 surface.
official_parameter_convention: delta_m3l_sq_ev2 = delta_m31_sq_ev2 for NO; delta_m3l_sq_ev2 = delta_m32_sq_ev2 for IO.
source: NuFIT 6.1 (2025), IC24 with SK-atm, Inverted Ordering; Gaussianized 1sigma approximation
